question: Should Code Mode receive an on-demand bridge for the full bodies of only the skills already eligible for that run’s prompt?
rationale: This is a new host-mediated content-read capability for the sandboxed Code Mode guest; the permanent boundary is a product and security decision, not only a mechanical implementation detail.

options.title: Approve the scoped bridge
options.body: Retain the prompt-derived eligible-skill set and require proof that Code Mode can read an eligible skill while an unlisted name is rejected.

options.title: Keep skills prompt-only
options.body: Do not expose skill bodies to Code Mode and retain the existing limitation until a different capability model is agreed.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped bridge
recommendation.body: Retain the prompt-derived eligible-skill set and require proof that Code Mode can read an eligible skill while an unlisted name is rejected.
